What's Changed
* Releases now wait for all checks, including real installs from Homebrew, Flatpak and Scoop by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/115
* Distribution tests now check the real first-run marker and handle UTF-16 icons by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/116
* Flatpak distribution test stops downloading a 20-minute apt dependency tree by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/117
* Distribution tests pass the remaining two channels by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/118
* The macOS distribution test no longer hangs on the first launch by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/119
* Distribution tests and their test-environment deviations are now documented by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/120
* Open projects from doru:// links in packaged builds, verified by the distribution tests by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/121
* Open projects from doru:// links on Linux and make the distribution tests exercise the real installs by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/123
* Bump the version to 0.0.26 by @borisovodov in https://github.com/borisovodov/doru/pull/124
